answer: Put Chartered port logistics coordinator manifest with port logistics certification at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 779 aliases need 779 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. What carries the ivory here is verification, the plume of cost is what stops the farm, and the violet of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
